detail: Year-one direct costs are $524,303. At $500,000 or more in any year NIH must agree in writing to accept the application, requested at least six weeks before submission; the program official has not agreed (NOT-OD-17-005).
F&A is charged on the full $375,000 Drumlin subaward; NIH still applies 45 CFR 75, under which only the first $25,000 of each subaward is in the MTDC base.
The PI's committed effort across current and pending support, including this project at 30%, totals 110%.

An A1 resubmission must include an Introduction responding to the prior summary statement; the draft does not address its critiques (third-aim preliminary data, PI effort, statistical plan, subaward role).
Draft claims 19 peer-reviewed papers from the prior award; the outcomes record and final report show 11.
